items.headline: LA-Area Voters Approve Wave of Hotel Tax Hikes Ahead of 2028 Olympics

items.headline: Turkey Earns More From Fewer Tourists, But Hotels Miss Out
items.body: Turkey is making more money from fewer visitors, but the gains come from longer stays, not pricier rooms: hotel rates fell in dollar terms. The lowered $65 billion target can be met even if fourth-quarter revenue drops 9%, so clearing it says little about a recovery.

items.headline: Travelers Want Less Screen Time and More Time on the Water
items.body: Travelers are moving from talking about getting outside to booking experiences that take them there. New research from Boatsetter points to growing participation in outdoor and water-based activities, creating opportunities for hospitality brands to make shared experiences more accessible.
